findings.comment: No dumpster or refuse collection facility location is shown on the site plan with required dimensions. Site plan currently proposes only curbside collection with no central trash facility identified. A central dumpster location with dimensions and maneuvering area must be shown to demonstrate that collection vehicle maneuvering is contained on-site without use of public right-of-way. The TPW-TDS reviewer comment (TPW 25) remains pending on this requirement.

Trash pickup and delivery locations relative to parking drive aisles and pedestrian corridors cannot be verified because no central trash collection facility is shown on the site plan. Once a dumpster location is identified, verification that it is located off main access aisles and away from all pedestrian corridors will be required.

Multi-Family Recycling Plan Form (required by Austin City Code § 15-6) completion and submittal status cannot be verified. No completed form or evidence of submission to Solid Waste Services Department is present in the site plan submittal or supplementary documents.

Recycling Plan Form submission status cannot be verified. The requirement to submit the form to Solid Waste Services within 14 days after buildings are occupied is a post-occupancy requirement; however, the form must be completed prior to approval and available for inspection.
Space for storage of recycling containers is not shown or identified on the site plan. A designated on-site recycling storage area must be provided and depicted with dimensions on the site plan.

Dumpster enclosure sizing cannot be verified because no dumpster facility is shown on the site plan. Once a dumpster location and enclosure are identified, dimensions must confirm that both trash and recycling containers fit simultaneously within the screened dumpster pad.

Recycling equipment location is not shown on the site plan. For a 39-unit multi-family project, recycling facilities are required outside the building by Austin City Code § 15-6, and their location must be depicted on the site plan.

Multi-building site does not clarify the number and location of dumpsters serving each of the eight buildings. Site plan does not demonstrate whether multiple dumpsters are proposed or whether a single shared facility is adequate for all 39 units across all buildings. This allocation must be clearly shown on the site plan.

Dumpster location and setback from SF-5 or more restrictive adjacent properties cannot be verified because no dumpster is shown on the site plan with distance measurements. The site is adjacent to an SF-3 parcel (which is SF-5 or more restrictive per the grouping definition). Once a dumpster location is identified, a minimum 20-foot setback from this property line must be demonstrated.

The required Compatibility section note is not present on the cover sheet. The standard note 'All dumpsters and any permanently placed refuse receptacles will be located at a minimum of twenty (20) feet from a property used or zoned as SF-5 or more restrictive' must be included in the site plan cover sheet Compatibility notes section. This is a standard requirement for all Austin site plans regardless of whether a Compatibility Standards provision is triggered.

Refuse collection area screening from adjacent residential properties cannot be verified because no central trash collection facility is shown on the site plan. The site is adjacent to residential properties (SF-3 parcel), which require screening per LDC § 25-2-1006(C). Once a dumpster location is identified, dimensions from the facility to the nearest residential property and screening details must be shown.

findings.comment: Commercial dumpster 10-foot fire safety clearance cannot be verified because no dumpster is shown on the site plan with location and dimensions. While the Fire Department note is present on Sheet 3 (correctly stating the 10-foot clearance requirement), compliance cannot be assessed without a depicted dumpster location and measured distances to building openings and combustible elements.

Garbage collection vehicle maneuvering cannot be verified as fully contained on-site because no dumpster facility is shown on the site plan. No turning radius or maneuvering area is depicted. A central trash facility location with sufficient on-site turning area for collection vehicles must be shown on the site plan to verify compliance.
